parameters.query:
SELECT
  l.id AS lead_id,
  l.phone_number,
  l.whatsapp_name,
  l.service,
  l.city,
  l.requirement,
  l.created_at,
  s.name AS seller_name
FROM leads l
LEFT JOIN sellers s ON s.id = l.assigned_seller_id
WHERE l.id = $1::bigint
  AND l.deleted_at IS NULL

INSERT INTO audit_logs (
  event_name,
  entity_type,
  entity_id,
  actor_type,
  actor_id,
  result,
  before_payload,
  after_payload,
  metadata
) VALUES (
  'whatsapp_group_notification',
  'lead',
  $1::bigint,
  'system',
  'n8n',
  CASE WHEN $2::boolean THEN 'sent' ELSE 'failed' END,
  '{}'::jsonb,
  COALESCE(NULLIF($3::text, '')::jsonb, '{}'::jsonb),
  COALESCE(NULLIF($4::text, '')::jsonb, '{}'::jsonb)
) RETURNING id;
